command: python3 -m sprat.cli add-user analyst analyst && P1=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create analyst policy "GDPR" --content "Regulation (EU) 2016/679" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && P2=$(python3 -m sprat.cli create analyst policy "ISO 27001" --content "Internal security rulebook" | python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])') && python3 -m sprat.cli create analyst requirement "Encrypt data at rest" --sources "$P1,$P2" --primary-source "$P1"
